title: Settings
displayNameHelp: Visible only to colleagues in your practice and on printed reports.
twoFactorHelp: The devices that generate your sign-in codes. You always need at least one.
backupFactorAdvice: Recommended: add a second device (for example the app on a tablet) so you are not locked out if you lose your phone.
pinHelp: The PIN is stored only on this device and is used to leave patient mode.
codePrefixHelp: 1 to 4 capital letters, e.g. PZ → PZ-7K3M. Applies to new patients.
idleTimeoutHelp: After this time without activity the session is closed.
retentionHelp: After this period raw data (movements, timing of every tap) is deleted; summary measures are kept.
membersHelp: Invited people receive an email and must turn on two-factor authentication at first sign-in.

backup.title: Encrypted backup
backup.help: Download a complete copy of the practice's data, encrypted on your computer with a passphrase only you know. Keep it on an external drive.
backup.never: No backup made from this device yet.
backup.passphraseWarning: If you forget the passphrase nobody can open the backup, not even the administrator.
backup.passphraseRule: At least 12 characters. A phrase of several words is best.
backup.restoreHelp: Re-import a backup into this practice. Existing data is not changed; patient codes and identifiers stay the same.

error.format: The file is not a Sinapsi backup.

dataStored: For each patient: a generated code, year of birth, sex, years of schooling, handedness, clinical conditions by category, sessions, results and detailed exercise recordings. No names, tax codes or full dates of birth.
dataWhere: Data is hosted in the European Union (Ireland) and encrypted in transit and at rest. Access requires a password and a second factor.
dataRetention: Detailed recordings are deleted automatically after {n} months; summary measures are kept until the patient is deleted.

audit.help: Every creation, change, deletion, export and restore is logged. The log cannot be modified.
